Name: Recommended Farm (Custom Overlay Icons for Farm Types)
Author: DylanJames
Description:
[center][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/games/stardewvalley/collections/oq13tr][img]https://files.catbox.moe/asi8cd.png[/img][/url][/center]
‎
[center][url=https://ko-fi.com/dylanjamesxyz][img]https://github.com/doodlum/nexusmods-widgets/blob/main/Ko-fi_40px_60fps.png?raw=true[/img][/url]  [url=https://discord.gg/pJ5wexKUx3][img]https://github.com/doodlum/nexusmods-widgets/blob/main/Discord_40px.png?raw=true[/img][/url]
[/center]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
[b][size=4]REQUIREMENTS[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
⧉ㅤ[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][b]SMAPI[/b][/url]

[b][size=4]DESCRIPTION[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
Marks farms with author-defined [b][color=#6aa84f]"Recommended"[/color][/b] and [b][color=#cc4125]"Challenge"[/color][/b] icons on the farm selection menu.
The tool tip will also display localized text below the name categorizing the farm as such.

This mod technically does nothing on its own. [b]You need to download one of the mods under [u]"Miscellaneous Files"[/u].[/b]
Mod authors may also use this to apply an icon to their farm as well. [s]If you have any suggestions, reach out to me...[/s]

[b][size=4]AVAILABLE PRESETS[/size][/b]

[b]Standard[/b] or [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Grandpa's Farm[/url] [/b]
[b]Wilderness Farm[/b]
[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Frontier Farm from Stardew Valley Expanded[/url][/b]
[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8913]Waterfall Forest Farms (WaFF and WAFFLE)[/url] [/b]
[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4572]Capitalist Dream Farm 2[/url][/b]

[b][size=4]AUTHOR GUIDE[/size][/b]
[size=1]ㅤ[/size]
You can add icons to existing farms like this. This is an example for Frontier Farm.
The possible icons are "Silver", "Gold", "Iridium", "Skull" and "None".

[code]{
  "Format": "2.9.0",
  "Changes": [
    {
      "Action": "EditData",
      "Target": "Mods/DylanJames.RecommendedFarm/Farms",
      "Entries": {
        "{{ModId}}/FrontierFarm": {
          "FarmID": "FrontierFarm",
          "ModID": "flashshifter.FrontierFarm",
          "Icon": "Gold"
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}[/code]
[url=https://codeberg.org/dylanjames-xyz/SaveJingle/][/url][b][url=https://codeberg.org/dylanjames-xyz/RecommendedFarm]Source Code[/url][/b]. Also see 'Mirrors'.
